# REQ: LANG-451 LANG-452 LANG-453 LANG-454
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(Demo VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

option(BUILD_TESTS "Build the tests" ON)
set(SOURCES src/main.c src/util.c)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT DEFINED ENV{CI})
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
elseif(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
  message(STATUS "Debug build in ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
endif()

add_executable(demo ${SOURCES})
target_link_libraries(demo PRIVATE m)

foreach(test IN ITEMS a b c)
  add_test(NAME test_${test} COMMAND demo --test ${test})
endforeach()

function(print_all)
  message("multi-line
string ${ARGN}")
endfunction()
